description: This file defines the CKEditor 5 Alignment plugin class for Drupal, including configuration, form building, validation, and element filtering methods.

classes.name: Alignment
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for CKEditor 5 alignment functionality, managing configuration, form interface, and element filtering.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the default configuration array for the plugin.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds a form for selecting enabled alignment options.

methods.name: validateConfigurationForm
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the form input for alignment options.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Saves the selected alignment options into plugin configuration.

methods.name: getDynamicPluginConfig
methods.description: Filters and returns the plugin configuration based on enabled alignments.

methods.name: getElementsSubset
methods.description: Returns a subset of CKEditor elements based on enabled alignments.
